newsitem.title: FRANCE: Britain's Blair to holiday in southern France.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Blair to holiday in southern France.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair will spend a few days next week on holiday in the village of Saint Martin d'Oydes in southwestern France, local officials said on Monday.
The village is located some 30 km (20 miles) from Cintegabelle, the main city in the parliamentary district represented by French Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin.
But there was no word from either the French or British side on the possibility that the two leftist leaders might get together during Blair's stay.
Village officials scheduled a special meeting of the town council to plan a reception for the visiting official.
The British premier, his wife Cherie and their children Nicholas, Kathryn and Euan will be staying in the home of David Keene, a London lawyer.
The stone house dates back to the 12th century. It has a swimming pool and a high stone wall.
